cashier.js.description: Manages Cashier Shift sessions (OPEN, CLOSED), Blind Drop Denomination Settlement, Over/Short mathematical calculation, and 4-Section Cashier Shift Printable Summary Report.

folio.js.description: Manages Guest & Master Folios, Charges, Payments, Paid Out, Voided transactions with required audit trail reasons, Bill Transfers, Routing rules, and Checkouts.

frontdesk.js.description: Frontdesk Dashboard, DataGrid, Tape Chart matrix, and Room Forecast calculations.

night_audit.js.description: End-of-day Night Audit processing, Pre-Audit checklist, EOD Flash Report generation and business date advancement.

blind_drop_method.description: During an active shift (OPEN), system expected cash totals are hidden from the cashier. Closing shift triggers Denomination Calculator modal (#modal-close-cashier-shift) where the user counts physical cash coins and notes manually. System expected cash and Over/Short are calculated only upon submission.

formula.system_net_cash: Total Cash Payments - Total Paid Out
formula.remittance_amount: Total Declared Cash - Petty Cash Retained
formula.over_short: Total Declared Cash - System Expected Cash

void_handling_strategy.description: Voided transactions (is_void = true or is_voided = true) require mandatory void_reason, voided_by, and voided_at. Voided amounts are excluded from Total Sales Revenue and expected drawer cash calculations, but appear in Section 4 (Voided Transactions) of the Cashier Shift Report for audit trail traceability.

paid_out_handling_strategy.description: Paid Out transactions (transaction_type = 'PAID_OUT' or category = 'PAID_OUT') represent cash drawer disbursements (e.g. staff expense). They reduce physical cash in drawer (Expected Cash) but do not represent hotel sales revenue. They are listed in Section 1 (Cash Movement) as Outflows.

close_shift_debouncing.description: Close Shift submission immediately disables #btnSubmitCloseShift with a loading spinner to prevent race conditions or duplicate submissions. Re-enables on error or re-open.

indexing_hints.description: Added JSDoc performance commentary in js/modules/cashier.js detailing recommended composite indexes on folio_transactions: idx_folio_tx_shift (cashier_shift_id, created_at) and idx_folio_tx_user_date (user_id, business_date).
